**Finding: compliant (rule inapplicable) — no redline.**

- **Where:** Article VIII (Termination), § 8.3 (p0363), reviewed alongside §§ 8.1–8.2 and Article X.
- **Why:** This is a transfer and servicing agreement in a securitization, not a subscription. The term is self-liquidating — it ends on the earlier of the last Receivable being paid in full/settled/sold/written off or termination of the Issuer under § 8.1 of the Trust Agreement — with optional acquisition and optional redemption exits in §§ 8.1–8.2.
- **Detection checks run:** "renew", "automatically renew", "successive", "extended for", "unless either party gives notice", "term of this Agreement" — no auto-renewal mechanic, no non-renewal notice window, and no renewal price-uplift language anywhere in the document.
- **Direction check:** No evergreen roll-forward the Servicer could impose on us, so no exit or pricing exposure to shorten or cap.
